$comment: The leagues' combo boss drops (Wiki: Demonic_Pacts_League#Combo_boss_drops, read 2026-11-23): 'Items that dropped as components that required multiple regions to create a usable item instead dropped as the finished item'. Applied by plugins/modes/league/ComboDrops.LeagueMode.js to a league character of a league in `leagues` (6 Demonic Pacts) on the rollers' loot ('npc-drops:roll' and 'drops:rolled'). Each part comes from its source alone, so a part is replaced wherever it drops; `part` and `finished` are cache gamevals. A finished item drops as one, whatever the part's stack (ours: the Colosseum's 2-3 echo crystals give one pair of echo boots). The page's 'All of The Forgotten Four dropped all pieces of the soul reaper axe' is not a swap and is not here.
